cohort: 110 pregnant women in Hormozgan, Iran (55 with COVID-19 and 55 without)
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 had a higher incidence of preterm labor compared to healthy pregnant women.
mod_finding: While the authors did not find a statistically significant difference in mode of delivery between groups, they did find that people who had COVID-19 during pregnancy had more than double the odds of preterm labor.
